To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
in adult C57 mice the tonotopic organization of auditory cortex is disrupted by sensorineural hearing impairment.

in C57 mice, there was a significant increase in the representation of high frequency sounds at 6 months of age (the age at which hearing loss is most profound) compared with 3 months, but not compared with 1.5 months.

in the AI of C57 mice, (a) the frequency representation of AI is stable during early adulthood, (b) the frequency representation is progressively compressed in older C57 mice, and (c) the frequency representation in AI is stable during adulthood in CBA mice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the auditory system responds to changes in the auditory input, particularly those changes that occur as a consequence of aging.
understanding the mechanisms of plasticity that underlie age-related hearing loss and the effects of such changes on neural function.
the plasticity of auditory cortical representations of frequency in adult C57 mice, which exhibit progressive, high frequency sensorineural hearing impairment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
“the auditory cortex is plastic and reorganizes itself in response to hearing loss.
the plasticity of AI is associated with hearing loss in C57 mice, but not in CBA mice.
the AI representation of frequency in young adult C57 mice is not significantly different from that of young adult CBA/Ca mice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the plasticity of AI in response to hearing loss in adult mice depends on both the age of the mice and the severity of the loss.
the representation of the frequency spectrum in AI is not static, but rather it is dynamic.
the plasticity of the auditory cortex is not as robust in the C57 mice as it is in the CBA/Ca mice.
The main takeaway from our work is that
hearing loss in C57 mice is accompanied by a loss in frequency tuning of the cortical neurons, as well as a reduction in the number of neurons that respond to sound.
the representation of frequency in AI is plastic in adult C57 mice, but not adult CBA mice, and that plasticity is associated with the onset of sensorineural hearing impairment in C57 mice.
the frequency map in AI of C57 mice becomes progressively more distorted as hearing declines with age.
